Let me analyze this conflict.

Axis: applicant
- Register: "Endress + Hauser GmbH + Co., KG"
- Document: "Endress+Hauser SE+Co. KG"

Are these the same entity? "Endress+Hauser GmbH + Co. KG" vs "Endress+Hauser SE+Co. KG". Hmm. The company "Endress+Hauser GmbH+Co. KG" (Maulburg, Germany) — actually, historically it was "Endress+Hauser GmbH+Co. KG" in Maulburg. In recent years, the German entity changed to "Endress+Hauser SE+Co. KG" (converted from GmbH to SE — Societas Europaea). This conversion happened around 2022-2023? Let me think. Actually, Endress+Hauser announced conversion of the German parent "Endress+Hauser GmbH+Co. KG" to "Endress+Hauser SE+Co. KG" — I believe this was around November 2023? Actually, the AGM 2023 approved the conversion to SE. So a 2019 certificate would say GmbH+Co. KG.

But regardless of the historical facts, for the conflict resolution task: the names differ in legal form suffix — "GmbH" vs "SE". The rules say "legal-suffix drift = same-entity". Is GmbH vs SE legal-suffix drift? SE is a genuinely different legal form (Societas Europaea), representing an actual corporate conversion. But the rules explicitly say legal-suffix drift = same-entity. The rules also say "Genuinely different company or person names = different-entity". Here the core company name "Endress+Hauser" is the same; only the legal form differs (GmbH+Co. KG vs SE+Co. KG). This is legal-suffix drift — same entity.

So verdict: same-entity. Best value: hmm, which one? The rules say for same-entity, "Number/year format differences that clearly denote the same certificate = same-entity with the register's canonical form." That's specific to number/year. For same-entity generally, what should best_value be? For document-noise, best_value from register. For different-entity, best_value from document. For same-entity, arguably the register's canonical form, since register is the database canonical. But the certificate is the legal instrument... The rules only specify: different-entity → document's value; document-noise → register's value. For same-entity, the canonical form seems reasonable — register's canonical form. Given the certificate is from 2019, "GmbH + Co., KG" would be historically correct; SE conversion happened later. The register value "Endress + Hauser GmbH + Co., KG" matches the issuing year. So best_value = "Endress + Hauser GmbH + Co., KG".

Why: Same company, only legal-suffix drift (GmbH vs SE), likely reflecting a later corporate-form change; register form fits the 2019 issue date.
